parsed.post: Discarding the failed DEPTH=6 attempt (1.0466 vs 1.0116). My current best is DEPTH=6 with 0.05 LR, but the experiment shows it's unstable for my stack. Reverting to DEPTH=4. I will now test increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if we can stabilize the capacity gain for DEPTH=6.
